name: Neon Harbour
description: Container cranes and neon over Victoria Harbour. The warehouse ships the machine's parts south, and its password is locked in the crane control room on the roof. Work up the dock, the hall and the gantry. As the soldier, hop the guarded container barge and fight down the hall. As the hacker, dive under the barge through the sluice gate and keep to the crane rail above the guards. Everyone needs the goggles for the hidden bridge and a USB key for the control room door.
